dos: Do ration red to at most 10 percent of the screen and lime to the live cue only.
Do pair every status color with a text label or icon.
donts: Don't use retro or skeuomorphic church-software chrome.
Don't use lime for anything that is not currently projecting.
keyCharacteristics: Dense three-pane control window with full keyboard reach.
Restrained palette with rationed red and lime.
narrative.overview: A quiet control room with one red signal and one live cue.

rules.body: Lime appears only on what is currently projecting.
rules.name: The Live Means Live Rule

rules.body: Signal red covers at most 10 percent of any control-window screen.
rules.name: The Ten Percent Rule
